metadata.short_desc: Auto-parse shared links from Bilibili, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Twitter, AcFun, NGA, GitHub, Pixiv and Steam
metadata.desc:
Auto-parse shared links from 11 platforms and render them as share cards, with a built-in Dashboard page.

- Just send a link in chat; no command needed
- Cards: 4 layouts x light/dark themes, adjustable accent color, gradient and watermark
- Dashboard: overview, manual parsing, parse cache, UI and card appearance, all settings
- When videos can't be sent across Docker containers, use a shared cache dir or the media relay

See the repository README for details. MIT licensed; parts of the parser framework and card renderer are based on astrbot_plugin_rika_share (MIT) and Johnserf-Seed/f2 (Apache-2.0).

denia.title: Hope Parser
denia.description: Overview, manual link parsing, parse-cache management, UI and card appearance customization, and full configuration.
